english_draft: AMD published its third quarter 2026 results on November 3, 2026. Revenue was 13.4 billion US dollars. Revenue increased 45 percent compared with the same quarter last year. The company said record Data Center revenue contributed partly to the growth. The press release provides GAAP and non-GAAP measures. The verified facts do not include margins, net income, or cash flow. There is no same-period Preview. Therefore, this analysis cannot compare a prior forecast with actual results. We do not know the exact Data Center revenue amount or its share. We do not know the trend of client, gaming, and embedded segments. For the next quarter, watch the Data Center growth trend and the other segments. Watch profitability metrics when AMD releases them.
reader_questions: 数据中心“创纪录”是指绝对金额新高，还是占总营收比重创新高？这会改变对增长结构的理解。
45% 的营收增长是否包含并购、涨价或汇率因素？没有相关说明时，内生增速与表面增速可能存在偏差。
GAAP 与非 GAAP 的利润差异未披露，投资者能否仅凭营收增速判断增长是否转化为现金流？
fact_checks: 核对发布日期：2026-11-03，与来源标题 'AMD Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results' 一致。
核对营收：13.4 billion USD，同比 +45%，与来源事实一致。
核对增长归因：公司称增长部分来自 record Data Center revenue，与来源事实一致。
核对 GAAP/非GAAP：来源提供单独口径，但已核事实未见具体利润数字，故不写。
核对 Preview：无同期财报前定稿；事后历史资料重建稿不作为预测复核。
核对单位：USD 13.4 billion 转换中文为 134 亿美元，无误。
